name: Fez
summary: Fez rewards slow exploration of its medina, workshops and historic schools. A reputable local guide can help orient the first walk while leaving independent time afterward.
seasonNote: Summer can be hot and winter wet; religious holidays affect daily rhythms.
arrival: Arrange the nearest accessible drop-off with your riad; vehicles cannot enter much of the old medina.
gettingAround: Walk the medina and use licensed taxis between districts. Allow extra time for navigating lanes.
cashTip: Carry small MAD notes for cafés, guides and markets; agree any guiding or viewing fee beforehand.
foodTip: Try pastilla, harira and Moroccan breads; ask about fillings and order from an established kitchen.
buyTip: Fez is known for ceramics, metalwork and leather; check quality and avoid rushed purchases.

connections.note: Approximate daytime journey around 7 hours; verify the current ONCF service.
